currentNativeStatus.exitCause: not-established; no matching VoiceOver DiagnosticReports file found

exitInterpretation.fullW7: All blockers must close and technical / human decisions remain separate; a passing scoped subset is not the full-project quality gate.
exitInterpretation.manualSupportBoundary: W7.4 and validation explicitly permit unverified actual environments to be documented as not-run; this does not manufacture a pass or silently discharge a blocker already registered as open.
exitInterpretation.Safari: The explicit user manual decision permits documenting the deferred supported-environment boundary. Do not resume automation or device authentication.
exitInterpretation.VoiceOver: No explicit user deferral, so attempt a smaller permission-preserving route; actual E3/E6 speech stays unverified until captured or an explicit scoped disposition is recorded.
exitInterpretation.contrast: Human completed; do not ask again or infer automatic Token conformance.

established: The AppleEvent permission probe returned -1744 without requesting consent.
The normal Utility checkbox click left AppleScript control at zero.
The caption System Events request returned -1712 in five seconds; no reader PID remained.
The earlier request returned -1728 because reader process was absent.
notEstablished: Why VoiceOver exited after a transient startup.
Whether a specific application window or entire-contents read caused the reader to exit.
Whether direct bounded Accessibility API or CUA caption screenshot will be available in this runtime.
noInference: No crash-report filename does not prove a clean exit.
A reader PID, installed dictionary, browser AX text or DOM attributes do not prove spoken output.

preferredRetry.ownerApproval: root controls execution; existing user authorization persists
preferredRetry.route: Normal Command-F5 + observed welcome Return; native keyboard to owned E3/E6; capture actual caption panel through relevant CUA app/window snapshot or narrowly bounded AXWindows/AXChildren read of confirmed VoiceOver PID.
preferredRetry.stabilityGate: Observe both real reader process and voiceOverOnOffKey true in two successive bounded samples before page navigation; never send another toggle without re-reading state.
preferredRetry.speechEvidence: Window owner PID/bundle, caption identity and raw caption text or image per actual key event; timestamps and E3/E6 selected identity.
preferredRetry.failureExit: If reader is unstable, no caption source exists, or existing accessibility capture lacks permission, record exact current failure and restore; no retry loop or workaround authentication.

officialReferences.claim: Caption panel shows current VoiceOver speech; default VO is Control and Option or Caps Lock.
Command-F5 toggles VoiceOver; welcome Return continues, Escape exits.
VO-Shift-Z saves last spoken phrase as audio plus troubleshooting logs to Desktop; not selected because logs may include unrelated context and Desktop lies outside current workspace.
General setting enables AppleScript control; existence does not establish permission.

caseTargets.action: Real keyboard reaches 当前题目选择 and 第1题 / 第2题 tabs, moves selection and enters current answer / scoring field
caseTargets.spokenExpected: Question label, tab role / selected state, correct student / question identity and 本题分数 numeric input semantics
caseTargets.notes: Exact wording follows actual installed Chinese VoiceOver; no hard-coded English phrase.

caseTargets.action: Real keyboard activates 隐藏资源队列 then reaches 展开资源队列 and restores
caseTargets.spokenExpected: Meaningful nearby restore button name; focus stays in visible controls, restored queue identity corresponds to preview.

caseTargets.action: Real keyboard moves to 下一份 or the next resource, then review editor
caseTargets.spokenExpected: Correct current R-042/R-057 resource and review-field name; no speech from hidden subtree.

restoration: If initially off, normal Command-F5 once only after confirming currently on; verify process / preference off.
Do not change caption1, scripting0, welcome1 if the previous originals are still current; independently inspect if any setting must change.
Stop only owned Chromium profile / children, leave user tabs and 5368 service.
Return original app foreground; preserve raw failed records.
